The hidden power dynamic is control over maritime logistics—particularly the Indian Ocean’s choke points. By bolstering indigenous shipbuilding and deep‑water dock capacity, India can become a gatekeeper, compelling both powers to negotiate on terms that respect Indian commercial interests.

Simultaneously, accelerate the development of the International North–South Transport Corridor and the Chabahar‑to‑Kolkata maritime link to reduce dependence on any single external supply line.
